cohort: Women with secondary infertility diagnosed with periadnexal and pelvic adhesions
finding: Laparoscopic adhesiolysis was found to be an effective treatment for mild to moderate periadnexal adhesions after cesarean section, but pregnancy outcomes were poor for severe adhesions.
mod_finding: This study examined laparoscopic adhesiolysis for treating infertility due to adhesions after cesarean section, finding it effective for mild to moderate adhesions but recommending IVF for severe cases.
